title.measuredLongestRealInstance: "How to Set Your Sitter Up for Success" = 8 words
title.note: h1.h2.u-mb-0 — takes .h2's 4.5rem/1.1 scale but keeps h1's Reckless Neue family and -.01em tracking, and .u-mb-0 drops it to weight 400. Net: Reckless Neue 400, not 900. Intentional.

cover.note: forced 1:1 square, 32px radius at EVERY breakpoint, letterboxed by object-fit: contain. alt="" on the original. This is a SEPARATE CMS field from the card cover; 9 of the 10 real posts serve the same file for both, and exactly one differs.

constraints.noHero: This template has no hero section at all. The post header IS the top of the page, and it is a plain div.section.u-pb-0, not a <header>.
constraints.forbiddenFieldsReason: Recon checked the raw HTML and the live DOM on two sample posts. Zero <time> elements exist. None of this data is on the original, so none of it is invented here.

motion.note: No entrance or scroll animation. Global .btn hover transitions only.

responsive.desktop: title column col-lg-6 and cover column col-lg-6 inside .container.cc-narrow, row-justify-between + row-align-center. Section padding 80px 0 0.
